messages:
Dana (Design): Pushed a new compact-mode variant for the Trace Viewer focusing on stacktrace density, inline frame copy, and export flows. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-trace-v1 — quick skim pls.
Lucas - Eng: Nice. Compact mode helps for long debug sessions. Two engineering notes: 1) reduce chevron size visually but keep 24px hit target, 2) copying a frame should be async to avoid blocking when frames are huge.
Priya - PM: Product preference: primary action is 'Download summary (CSV)'. Secondary: 'Download full trace (ndjson)'. Tertiary: 'Copy selected frames (JSON)'. Add size estimate for full traces and require confirmation > 8MB.
Martin (A11y): Accessibility nits: copy buttons need aria-labels (e.g., "Copy stack frame to clipboard"). Export menu must toggle aria-expanded and set role=menu for assistive tech. Also add a polite live region that announces "Export started" and updated percentage.
Dana (Design): Will update microcopy and add sr-only text for copy success states. Thinking about an inline toast that reads: "Frame copied" with a link: "Open frame in new tab" for permalinks.
Lucas - Eng: Permalinks: for hosted orgs we can return stable links with masked IDs; for Private/Dedicated orgs generate ephemeral signed tokens (ttl=3600s). Backend will expose /api/v1/shares. For full exports we'll stream ndjson and emit progress via SSE.
Priya - PM: Important: org flag to disable full exports for customers with policy restrictions. If full export is disabled show a redacted-export mode with PII removed and a tooltip explaining why.
Martin (A11y): Keyboard suggestions: when a row is focused: Enter = expand, C = copy corr-id or frame, S = download summary, Shift+S = download full trace. Scope shortcuts only when the trace-list has active focus and show the key hints in the row affordance.
Dana (Design): UX nit: tooltip delay for copy icons felt long in user tests. Reduce to 250ms and ensure it doesn't block keyboard focus. Also add visible focus ring for high contrast themes.
Lucas - Eng: Implementation caveat: copying via navigator.clipboard.writeText is fine but fallback required for older browsers. For huge text blobs we'll chunk and call postMessage to a worker to avoid main-thread freeze. Also ensure focus isn't lost on copy action.
Priya - PM: Acceptance criteria for the ticket: 1) compact-mode visuals + larger hit targets 2) inline async copy for frames + accessible toasts 3) export menu with Quick/Full/Selected + size estimate + cancelable progress + org flag gating 4) permalink behavior per org type + copy toast messaging 5) keyboard shortcuts documented + conflict matrix 6) accessibility checklist in PR.
ci-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/trace-compact-mode-v1.png
Dana (Design): I'll push updated Figma with the high-contrast chevrons, sr-only copy labels, smaller tooltip delay, and a compact-mode toggle. Also adding a no-JS fallback that opens the share modal for copy/permalink.
Martin (A11y): Also ensure live-region is polite and announces only high-level status (e.g., "Export started: 12%") to avoid screenreader flooding.
Lucas - Eng: Scheduling a dev handoff Wed 9:30. I'll attach backend tasks: share tokens, export streaming + SSE, size estimate header, and feature-flag per org.
Priya - PM: Thanks all. Tag the product ticket when mocks are updated; include the a11y checklist in the PR description.
